name: Rezi
tagline: Rezi is an AI resume builder specifically engineered to score well with applicant tracking systems (ATS) — the software that filters most resumes before a human sees them. Its AI analyses your content against ATS criteria and provides a real-time score with specific suggestions for improvement. Job seekers frustrated by sending applications into the void use Rezi to ensure their resume clears the algorithmic gatekeeper.
